hero.name: Ink Well
hero.tagline:
Write your screenplay anywhere.
No internet. No excuses.

lines.text: The café is quiet. JAMES, 30s, worn jacket, stares at a blank notebook.
He picks up the pen. Smiles.

features.title: Industry-Standard Formatting
features.body: Automatic slug lines, action, character cues, dialogue, and transitions — formatted perfectly as you type. No manual spacing. Ever.

features.icon: <svg viewBox='0 0 40 40' fill='none'><path d='M20 8v16M14 18l6 6 6-6' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/><path d='M10 30h20' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='.5'/></svg>
features.title: Auto-Save
features.body: Every keystroke saved instantly. Never lose a word — even if the app closes unexpectedly.

features.icon: <svg viewBox='0 0 40 40' fill='none'><circle cx='20' cy='20' r='12' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.5'/><path d='M20 14v6l4 4' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/></svg>
features.title: Works Offline, Always
features.body: No Wi-Fi? No problem. Write on a plane, in the mountains, anywhere — completely disconnected.

features.icon: <svg viewBox='0 0 40 40' fill='none'><rect x='8' y='8' width='10' height='14' rx='2' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.5'/><rect x='22' y='14' width='10' height='18' rx='2' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.5'/><path d='M8 28h24' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1' opacity='.4' stroke-linecap='round'/></svg>
features.title: Scene Navigator
features.body: Jump between scenes in a flash. Your entire screenplay always one tap away, beautifully organized.

features.icon: <svg viewBox='0 0 40 40' fill='none'><circle cx='20' cy='16' r='6' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.5'/><path d='M8 32c0-6.627 5.373-12 12-12s12 5.373 12 12' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='.5'/></svg>
features.title: Character Tracking
features.body: Keep track of every character in your script. Ink Well learns names as you write and auto-completes them, keeping your cast organized.

features.icon: <svg viewBox='0 0 40 40' fill='none'><path d='M10 10h20v4H10zM10 20h14M10 28h18' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/></svg>
features.title: Export Ready
features.body: Export your finished screenplay as a PDF or plain text file, formatted and ready to send.

features.icon: <svg viewBox='0 0 40 40' fill='none'><path d='M20 6l3 9h9l-7 5 3 9-8-6-8 6 3-9-7-5h9z' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/></svg>
features.title: Distraction-Free Mode
features.body: Full-screen writing mode strips everything away. Just you and your story — nothing else.

steps.title: Install & Open
steps.body: Download Ink Well on Android or iOS. No account required. No sign-in. Just open and write.

steps.title: Start Writing
steps.body: Tap new screenplay. The editor formats your work automatically as you type — just focus on the story.

steps.title: Save & Export
steps.body: Everything auto-saves locally. When you're ready, export as a PDF to share with directors, producers, or studios.
